ceno-.translation: [前缀]表示“普通, 共同”之义

cenobian.translation: a. 寺院的, 修道士的

cenobite.definition: n. a member of a religious order living in common

cenobitical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a cenobite.

cenobitism.definition:
n. The state of being a cenobite; the belief or practice
   of a cenobite.
cenobitism.translation: n. 修道士生活, 修道院制

cenogamy.definition:
n. The state of a community which permits promiscuous sexual
   intercourse among its members, as in certain societies practicing
   communism.
cenogamy.translation: n. 共夫共妻制(如原始社会)

cenogenesis.definition: n. introduction during embryonic development of characters or structure not present in the earlier evolutionary history of the strain or species (such as the addition of the placenta in mammalian evolution)
cenogenesis.translation:
n. 新性发生
[医] 新性发生

cenogenetic.definition: a of or relating to cenogenesis

cenophobia.translation: [医] 广厅恐怖, 新事物恐怖

cenospecies.translation: n. [单复同][生]群型种,杂交种

cenotaph.definition: n. a monument built to honor people whose remains are interred elsewhere or whose remains cannot be recovered
cenotaph.translation: n. 纪念碑, 衣冠冢

cenotaphs.definition: n. a monument built to honor people whose remains are interred elsewhere or whose remains cannot be recovered
cenotaphs.translation: n. 纪念碑, 衣冠冢, 纪念塔( cenotaph的复数形式 )

cenozoic.definition:
n. approximately the last 63 million years
a. of or relating to or denoting the Cenozoic era
cenozoic.translation:
n. 新生代, 新生界
a. 新生代的, 新生界的
